blocks.orig: Pamoja Migration Camp is a mobile camp that follows the Great Migration across the Serengeti. From December to April, it is set up in Ndutu for the calving season, where thousands of wildebeest give birth, and predators lurk nearby – the true ‘circle of life’ unfolding before your eyes. The camp has 14 canvas tents, including family suites, each with comfortable beds and a veranda that opens up to views of the surrounding wilderness. While here, you enjoy freshly prepared meals under canvas or beneath the stars, and evenings are spent around the campfire sharing stories of the day’s adventures. Simple yet immersive, the camp keeps you close to the action as the migration moves across the plains.

Between December and April it stands in Ndutu for the calving season, when thousands of wildebeest give birth while predators wait close by – the real ‘circle of life’ happening right in front of you. The camp has 14 canvas tents, family suites among them, each with comfortable beds and a veranda looking out over the wild surroundings. During your stay you eat freshly prepared meals under canvas or under the stars, and in the evening you gather at the campfire to share stories about the day’s adventures. Simple but immersive, the camp keeps you near the action as the migration crosses the plains.
